{{Top|leg}}
The '''Aerie Casino opening''' was held in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] to mark the opening of the [[Aerie Casino]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The occasion was marked by a blood sport competition between various exotic animals pitted against each other. In the initial rounds, creatures from the same region fought each other, with the survivors progressing to other rounds. The eventual winner was a [[flit]] which defeated a [[malkloc]] in the final.

[[Tendau Nandon]] and [[Dusque Mistflier]] attended the opening.
